version: Riftbound Core Rules 1.5 (checked 2026-11-08), see provenance per rule

mainDeckSize.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.3: a Main Deck of at least 40 cards (riftboundfaq.com/reference/core-rules/1.5)

includesChosenChampion.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.3: the 40 cards are a Chosen Champion plus Units, Gear and Spells

copyLimit.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.3.b: up to 3 copies of the same named card, chosen champion included

copyLimitAppliesAcrossSideboard.source: Reviewer and community sources; sideboards are not in the Core Rules, they are a Tournament Rules matter

signatureLimit.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.3.d (103.2.d in 1.0): a deck may only contain a sum total of 3 Signature cards, regardless of name. Sideboard handling: see signatureLimitAppliesAcrossSideboard.

signatureLimitAppliesAcrossSideboard.source: Rule 103.3.d sits under the Main Deck and is silent on sideboards. Conservative reading: signature cards in main plus sideboard count together, so a swap can never break the limit. Set false to count main only.

signatureRequiresMatchingLegend.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.3.d: Signature cards must share the Legend champion tag

runeDeckSize.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.4.a: exactly 12 Rune cards

runeDomains.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.4.a.1: runes must fit the Domain Identity. No rule requires a split across the two domains, so 12 runes of one domain are legal.

battlefieldCount.source: Rule 103.5.a: set by the Mode of Play. 3 is the 1v1 standard in community sources.

battlefieldCopyLimit.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.5.c: at most one of each same-named Battlefield

colorlessAlwaysLegal.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.2.b.5: a card with no domain fits any identity. The data labels such cards Colorless.

legendCount.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.2.a: exactly one Champion Legend

sideboardSizes.source: Not in the Core Rules. Sources conflict: 0 or 8 versus 10. Kept as a warning.

sideboardTypes.source: Assumed: a sideboard swaps main deck cards, so only main deckable types. Not in the Core Rules.

openingHandSize.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 116: each player draws 4

mulliganMax.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 117.1: up to two cards set aside, redraw that many, recycle the set-aside cards

championStartsOutsideLibrary.source: Core Rules 1.5 rule 103.3.a: the Chosen Champion starts in the Champion Zone
